## Triage (batch 5)

Drafted with `--per-memory 2` over all 20 catalog memories (`magpie/auto/deepseek-v4.1-flash:low`,
$0.011402, 40 rows). **Nothing was promoted**, and unlike batches 3–4 the drafter
produced no negative candidates at all, so this batch could not touch the
precision side.

Each of the nine flagged rows fails for a reason the dataset already carries:

- `cand-mem-archived-咱们之前那个旧版配置格式` (inject, expects `mem-archived`) is
  the wrong expectation, not a defect: archived memories never reach
  `planInjection` (that surface returns `no_match`), so the inject-side contract
  is exactly that they do not arrive. Archived reachability is a `search`-surface
  question and is covered there.
- `cand-mem-i18n-我要改一个按钮上的英文提示` (inject) is a real boundary of the
  strong-signal rule: `翻译` is a substring of the keyword `文案翻译`, not a whole
  token, and the rule needs two independent tokens or a leading keyword. That
  class already has one sample (`inject-implicit-migration`), and the rule itself
  was measured when it landed.
- Five search rows are the every-token-AND class: the query carries the right
  keywords plus one term no memory contains (`格式说明`, `放在哪，怎么校验`,
  `周期和灰度顺序`), so the conjunction is empty by construction. `strategies.mjs`
  prices this (audit 其十三) and the `search-comp-*` rows already sample it.
- Two search rows are sentence-shaped, and a raw user sentence is not the index
  query the search surface is asked with in the failure cases we care about; the
  intentional samples for "the agent's own wording does not retrieve" are the
  `search-*` rows.
- `cand-mem-other-port-我要给另一个项目写部署脚` asks about the other project from
  inside `p-memory-eval`; the scope boundary is deliberately sampled by
  `inject-cross-project-other`.

The 31 `agree` rows are keyword phrases the matcher already serves. Counting
expected-id coverage per memory per surface in `cases.jsonl` shows nothing to
fill: inject rows per memory run 1–4 and search rows 1–3, with `mem-archived` at
0/0 by contract. Promoting those rows would raise the case count without adding
a behaviour anybody is unsure about — the honest next rows are labelled *real*
questions (the coverage work), not more drafts of the same catalog.

`candidates.batch-5.jsonl` is kept so the rows can be re-checked after a matcher
change; the dataset stays at 99 rows.
